release: Scope-Native Downloads Projection & SAB Probe Efficiency
name: Scope-Native Downloads Projection & SAB Probe Efficiency
changes: Makes routine Live Downloads projection scope-native: only terminal records still visible in SAB History (or the existing brief Completed continuity bridge) contribute to global terminal counts, while retired ledger-only history and Completed/Failed card/collection dictionaries are not materialized before the Live API filters them away.

Changes the presentation state gate from a retry/sleep loop to one non-blocking in-memory lock attempt, eliminating scheduler-driven overshoot now that disk/JSON reconciliation is already background-only.

Uses recent authenticated SAB API success to bypass redundant fingerprints only after the pinned SAB generation is already proven; unknown/older generations still reach strict upgrade identity checks, while proven-current fingerprints establish a five-minute sparse boundary.
Adds scope-native projection telemetry for requested scope, Live-native build count, terminal records skipped from Live projection and last projected job count.

Preserves v3.6.51 cached engine status, SAB ownership handoff grace and episode-based overlap telemetry; v3.6.50 Queue/History sampling/deferred persistence, v3.6.49 bounded Downloads data plane, strict Smart Import ownership, Library Integrity, Selected Episodes/PAR2 visibility and private SABnzbd 5.1.2 remain intact.
regression_guards: All established automation identity, Library Integrity, quality, Selected Episodes, PAR2/repair, v3.6.49 data-plane, v3.6.50 sampler/state-lock and v3.6.51 heavy-load guards remain mandatory.

v3.6.52 structurally requires snapshot_view(scope=live) to request snapshot(scope=live), and the Live-native builder must skip terminal-only projection while retaining only the terminal counts the established full presentation would expose.

A synthetic 250 visible Completed + 100 retired ledger-only Completed + 10 Live fixture must return exactly 10 Live jobs, report exactly 250 Completed globally, skip at least 350 terminal projections and mark scope_native_projection=true.
The presentation state gate must perform exactly one non-blocking local-lock attempt with no sleep/retry loop or disk access.

ensure_running may bypass the version boundary on recent authenticated API success only when the running SAB generation is already proven current; unknown generations must still reach the boundary, and a proven current version must set the sparse recheck cooldown.
The release workflow runs the carried v3.6.50 and v3.6.51 guards plus the new v3.6.52 guard before any Windows release assets are built.
